## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (69%)** · Confident · Careful review
Slide prediction is Benign [F1], but regions 8–11 show 98%–100% invasive risk and positive surgical margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 69%, Invasive 29%, InSitu 2%, Normal 0% (ECE 5%) | Favors benign; notable invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 10% alpha (90% dataset coverage, n=132) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 90th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] (AUROC 70%) | Passes QC; no reliability flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Models agree with each other |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign [F5], 1 InSitu (83%), 1 Invasive (82%) | Mixed neighbors; 60% match benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.64) [F2]; unreliable concept (0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 3) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.60) lowers invasive risk [F3] (18/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 0) · context · Above-typical score (-0.42), descriptive context only [F4] (8/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 8, 9, 10) · ↑ invasive · High nuclear atypia (+0.32) in inferior row (18/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Elevated stromal invasion (+0.28) in highest-risk tile (19/20 spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability versus random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); top driver normal_lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasive carcinoma in regions 8–11 (98%–100% tile risk) is diluted by benign regions 0–5 (0%–2% risk).
- Tubule-rich regions 1–4 represent in situ or well-differentiated carcinoma, matching contrast case BACH_0063 (InSitu) or BACH_0278 (Invasive).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 10, 11**: Check 98%–100% risk tiles for invasion; inferior (430 um), lateral (108 um) margins.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 3, 4**: Verify benign tubules (regions 1–3) versus duct-confined atypia (region 4, contrast BACH_0063).
3. **Regions 6, 7**: Inspect intermediate-risk transition tiles (43% and 24% risk) bordering the high-risk inferior row.
